entry.title: Fix: Add file-based migration lock to prevent SQLite locking issues in multi-worker gunicorn
entry.content:
commit 4652cde5156c72b9f41b0847dfa57de72587095f parent feab64555d0c0b6ea05923bc6e3324b935e0208f Author: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com> Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:57:13 -0300
Fix: Add file-based migration lock to prevent SQLite locking issues in multi-worker gunicorn
The init_db() function was being called in each gunicorn worker process, causing concurrent SQLite migrations that led to 'unable to open database file' errors due to WAL mode locking conflicts. Added a file-based lock using fcntl to ensure only one worker runs migrations at a time.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
